      274+
      <p>Every step from the paper — tokenize, embed, project to Q/K/V, score, scale, softmax, weight, multi-head, concat — runs in your browser with real (small) matrices. Deterministic: same sentence always gives same numbers.</p>

      348+
      <p class="step-explainer">Three learned weight matrices <code>W^Q, W^K, W^V</code> (each <code>d_model × d_k</code>) turn each embedding into three new vectors. <strong style="color: var(--coral)">Query</strong> = "what I want", <strong style="color: var(--blue)">Key</strong> = "what I offer", <strong style="color: var(--purple)">Value</strong> = "what I carry".</p>
      349+
      <div class="step-body">

      353+

      <div id="vMatrix"></div>

      </div>

      </div>

      359+
      <!-- STEP 4: SCORES -->

      <div class="step">
      361+
      <div class="step-header">
      362+
      <div class="step-num">4</div>
      363+
      <h3>Raw attention scores: Q · K<sup>T</sup></h3>
      364+
      <span class="step-eq">scores ∈ ℝ<sup>n × n</sup></span>
      365+
      </div>
      366+
      <p class="step-explainer">Dot-product every Query with every Key. <code>scores[i][j]</code> = how much token <em>i</em> wants from token <em>j</em>. Big number = strong match.</p>
      367+
      <div class="step-body">
      368+
      <div id="scoreMatrix"></div>
      369+
      </div>
      370+
      </div>

      372+

      <div class="step">
      374+
      <div class="step-header">
      375+
      <div class="step-num">5</div>

      <span class="step-eq">scores / √d<sub>k</sub></span>
      378+
      </div>
      379+
      <p class="step-explainer">Without scaling, large d<sub>k</sub> creates huge dot-products → softmax saturates → gradients vanish. Dividing by √d<sub>k</sub> keeps values in a useful range.</p>
      380+
      <div class="step-body">
      381+

      </div>
      384+
      </div>

      386+

      <div class="step">
      388+
      <div class="step-header">
      389+

      <span class="step-eq">A = softmax(scores)</span>
      392+
      </div>
      393+
      <p class="step-explainer">Apply softmax row by row. Each row now sums to 1 — interpret as percentages: how much of token <em>i</em>'s attention goes to each other token.</p>
      394+
      <div class="step-body">
      395+
      <div class="legend">
      396+
      <span class="chip"><span class="dot" style="background: rgba(201,100,66,0.15);"></span> low</span>
      397+
      <span class="chip"><span class="dot" style="background: rgba(201,100,66,0.55);"></span> medium</span>

      </div>

      <div id="weightsMatrix"></div>

      402+
      </div>
      403+
      </div>
      404+
      405+
      <!-- STEP 7: OUTPUT -->

      <div class="step-header">

      </div>
      412+
      <p class="step-explainer">Each token's new vector = weighted sum of all Values, using attention weights. The word is now <em>contextualized</em> — it carries information from the words it attended to.</p>
      413+
      <div class="step-body">
      414+
      <div class="focus-row">
      415+

      </div>

      </div>
      421+
      </div>
      422+
      423+

      <div class="step">
      425+
      <div class="step-header">
      426+

      </div>
      430+
      <p class="step-explainer">Run h separate attention computations in parallel — each with its own <code>W^Q, W^K, W^V</code>. Each head learns a different relationship pattern (one might track subject↔verb, another track noun↔modifier, etc).</p>
      431+
      <div class="step-body">
      432+
      <div class="head-tabs" id="headTabs"></div>

      <div id="headPanels"></div>

      <h4 style="font-size: 14px; color: var(--green); margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 8px;">Final output (all heads concatenated)</h4>

      <div id="finalOutput"></div>
      436+

      437+
      </div>
      438+
      </div>

      440+
      </div>

      442+
      <footer>
      443+
      Local demo · numbers reproducible from seed · all math runs in your browser ·
      444+

      447+
      <script>
      448+
      /* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      449+
      Deterministic PRNG (mulberry32)
      450+
      ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
      451+
      function mulberry32(seed) {
      452+
      return function() {
      453+
      seed |= 0; seed = seed + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0;
      454+
      let t = seed;
      455+
      t = Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 15, t | 1);
      456+
      t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, t | 61);
      457+
      return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
      458+
      };
      459+
      }
      460+
      461+
      function gaussian(rng) {
      462+
      // Box-Muller
      463+
      const u = 1 - rng(); const v = rng();
      464+
      return Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * v) * 0.5;
      465+
      }
      466+
      467+
      // Stable string-to-seed
      468+
      function strHash(s) {
      469+
      let h = 0;
      470+
      for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) {
      471+
      h = ((h << 5) - h) + s.charCodeAt(i);
      472+
      h |= 0;
      473+
      }
      474+
      return Math.abs(h) + 1;
      475+
      }
      476+
      477+
      /* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      478+
      Matrix ops
      479+
      ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
      480+
      function makeMatrix(rows, cols, rng) {
      481+
      const m = [];
      482+
      for (let i = 0; i < rows; i++) {
      483+
      const row = [];
      484+
      for (let j = 0; j < cols; j++) row.push(gaussian(rng));
      485+
      m.push(row);
      486+
      }
      487+
      return m;
      488+
      }
      489+
      490+
      function matmul(a, b) {
      491+
      const n = a.length, k = a[0].length, m = b[0].length;
      492+
      const out = Array.from({length: n}, () => new Array(m).fill(0));
      493+
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      494+
      for (let j = 0; j < m; j++) {
      495+
      let s = 0;
      496+
      for (let p = 0; p < k; p++) s += a[i][p] * b[p][j];
      497+
      out[i][j] = s;
      498+
      }
      499+
      }
      500+
      return out;
      501+
      }
      502+
      503+
      function transpose(m) {
      504+
      const rows = m.length, cols = m[0].length;
      505+
      const out = Array.from({length: cols}, () => new Array(rows));
      506+
      for (let i = 0; i < rows; i++) for (let j = 0; j < cols; j++) out[j][i] = m[i][j];
      507+
      return out;
      508+
      }
      509+
      510+
      function scale(m, s) {
      511+
      return m.map(row => row.map(v => v * s));
      512+
      }
      513+
      514+
      function softmaxRows(m) {
      515+
      return m.map(row => {
      516+
      const max = Math.max(...row);
      517+
      const exp = row.map(v => Math.exp(v - max));
      518+
      const sum = exp.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
      519+
      return exp.map(v => v / sum);
      520+
      });
      521+
      }
      522+
      523+
      function concatCols(matrices) {
      524+
      const n = matrices[0].length;
      525+
      const out = [];
      526+
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      527+
      out.push(matrices.flatMap(m => m[i]));
      528+
      }
      529+
      return out;
      530+
      }
      531+
      532+
      /* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      533+
      Rendering helpers
      534+
      ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
      535+
      function fmt(x, d = 2) {
      536+
      if (!isFinite(x)) return "–";
      537+
      return x.toFixed(d);
      538+
      }
      539+
      540+
      function renderMatrix(matrix, rowLabels, colLabels, options = {}) {
      541+
      const klass = options.class || "";
      542+
      let html = `<div class="matrix-wrap"><table class="matrix ${klass}">`;
      543+
      html += "<tr><th></th>";
      544+
      for (const c of colLabels) html += `<th>${c}</th>`;
      545+
      html += "</tr>";
      546+
      for (let i = 0; i < matrix.length; i++) {
      547+
      html += `<tr><th>${rowLabels[i]}</th>`;
      548+
      for (let j = 0; j < matrix[i].length; j++) html += `<td>${fmt(matrix[i][j])}</td>`;
      549+
      html += "</tr>";
      550+
      }
      551+
      html += "</table></div>";
      552+
      return html;
      553+
      }
      554+
      555+
      function renderHeatmap(matrix, rowLabels, colLabels, title = "attention weight") {
      556+
      let html = `<div class="matrix-wrap"><table class="heatmap-table">`;
      557+
      html += "<tr><th></th>";
      558+
      for (const c of colLabels) html += `<th>${c}</th>`;
      559+
      html += "</tr>";
      560+
      for (let i = 0; i < matrix.length; i++) {
      561+
      html += `<tr><th>${rowLabels[i]}</th>`;
      562+
      for (let j = 0; j < matrix[i].length; j++) {
      563+
      const v = matrix[i][j];
      564+
      const alpha = Math.min(1, 0.06 + v * 1.4);
      565+
      const fg = v > 0.35 ? "white" : "var(--ink)";
      566+
      html += `<td class="heatmap-cell" style="background: rgba(201, 100, 66, ${alpha}); color: ${fg};" title="${rowLabels[i]} → ${colLabels[j]} = ${fmt(v, 4)}">${fmt(v)}</td>`;
      567+
      }
      568+
      html += "</tr>";
      569+
      }
      570+
      html += "</table></div>";
      571+
      return html;
      572+
      }
      573+
      574+
      /* ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      575+
      Main attention pipeline
      576+
      ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
      577+
      let STATE = {};
      578+
      579+
      function tokenize(sentence) {
      580+
      return sentence.trim().toLowerCase().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
      581+
      }
      582+
      583+
      function embed(tokens, dModel) {
      584+
      // Deterministic embedding per token text
      585+
      const E = [];
      586+
      for (const tok of tokens) {
      587+
      const rng = mulberry32(strHash(tok));

      const row = [];
      589+
      for (let i = 0; i < dModel; i++) row.push(gaussian(rng));
      590+
      E.push(row);
      591+
      }
      592+
      return E;
      593+
      }
      594+
      595+
      function runAttention() {
      596+
      const sentence = document.getElementById("sentenceInput").value;
      597+
      const dModel = parseInt(document.getElementById("dModel").value);
      598+
      const nHeads = parseInt(document.getElementById("nHeads").value);
      599+
      const seed = parseInt(document.getElementById("seed").value);
      600+
      601+
      const tokens = tokenize(sentence);
      602+
      if (tokens.length < 2) {
      603+
      alert("Please enter at least 2 words.");
      604+
      return;
      605+
      }
      606+
      607+
      const dK = Math.max(1, Math.floor(dModel / nHeads));
      608+
      609+
      // 1. Tokenize
      610+
      renderTokens(tokens);
      611+
      612+
      // 2. Embed
      613+
      const E = embed(tokens, dModel);
      614+
      document.getElementById("embedMatrix").innerHTML = renderMatrix(
      615+
      E, tokens,
      616+
      Array.from({length: dModel}, (_, i) => `d${i}`)
      617+
      );
      618+
      619+
      // Multi-head setup
      620+
      const heads = [];
      621+
      for (let h = 0; h < nHeads; h++) {
      622+

      623+

      624+
      const WK = makeMatrix(dModel, dK, rng);

      const WV = makeMatrix(dModel, dK, rng);

      const V = matmul(E, WV);
      629+
      const scoresRaw = matmul(Q, transpose(K));

      634+
      }
      635+
      636+
      // Display HEAD 0 as the primary example through steps 3-7
      637+
      const h0 = heads[0];
      638+
      const kCols = Array.from({length: dK}, (_, i) => `d${i}`);
      639+
      640+
      // 3. Q, K, V
      641+
      document.getElementById("qShape").textContent = `(${tokens.length} × ${dK})`;
      642+
      document.getElementById("kShape").textContent = `(${tokens.length} × ${dK})`;
      643+
      document.getElementById("vShape").textContent = `(${tokens.length} × ${dK})`;
      644+
      document.getElementById("qMatrix").innerHTML = renderMatrix(h0.Q, tokens, kCols, {class: "q"});
      645+
      document.getElementById("kMatrix").innerHTML = renderMatrix(h0.K, tokens, kCols, {class: "k"});
      646+
      document.getElementById("vMatrix").innerHTML = renderMatrix(h0.V, tokens, kCols, {class: "v"});
      647+
      648+
      // 4. Raw scores

      document.getElementById("scoreMatrix").innerHTML = renderMatrix(h0.scoresRaw, tokens, tokens);
      650+
      651+
      // 5. Scaled
      652+
      document.getElementById("scaleFactor").textContent = `√${dK} ≈ ${Math.sqrt(dK).toFixed(3)}`;

      document.getElementById("scaledMatrix").innerHTML = renderMatrix(h0.scoresScaled, tokens, tokens);
      654+
      655+
      // 6. Weights heatmap
      656+
      document.getElementById("weightsMatrix").innerHTML = renderHeatmap(h0.weights, tokens, tokens);
      657+
      document.getElementById("readToken").textContent = tokens[Math.min(1, tokens.length - 1)];
      658+
      document.getElementById("readToken2").textContent = tokens[Math.min(1, tokens.length - 1)];
      659+
      660+
      // 7. Output + focus calc
      661+
      document.getElementById("outputMatrix").innerHTML = renderMatrix(h0.out, tokens, kCols, {class: "v"});
      662+
      populateFocus(tokens);
      663+
      renderFocusCalc(h0, tokens, 0);
      664+
      665+
      // 8. Multi-head
      666+
      renderMultiHead(heads, tokens, dK, kCols);
      667+
      668+
      // Token callout
      669+
      document.getElementById("tokenCallout").innerHTML =
      670+
      `Got <strong>${tokens.length}</strong> tokens. Vocabulary size in real models: 30,000 – 200,000. We're using a deterministic per-string embedding so identical words map to identical vectors.`;
      671+
      672+
      STATE = { tokens, E, heads, dModel, dK, nHeads, kCols };
      673+
      }
      674+
      675+
      function renderTokens(tokens) {
      676+
      let html = "";
      677+
      tokens.forEach((t, i) => {
      678+
      html += `<div class="token-badge">${t}<span class="id">id=${strHash(t) % 10000}</span></div>`;
      679+
      });
      680+
      document.getElementById("tokenRow").innerHTML = html;
      681+
      }
      682+
      683+
      function populateFocus(tokens) {
      684+
      const sel = document.getElementById("focusToken");

      686+
      sel.onchange = () => renderFocusCalc(STATE.heads[0], STATE.tokens, parseInt(sel.value));
      687+
      }
      688+
      689+
      function renderFocusCalc(head, tokens, idx) {
      690+
      const weights = head.weights[idx];
      691+
      const V = head.V;
      692+
      const out = head.out[idx];
      693+
      694+
      // Build calculation text
      695+
      let html = `<h4>Computing output for "${tokens[idx]}" (row ${idx})</h4>`;
      696+
      html += `<div class="formula">output[${idx}] = `;
      697+
      const parts = [];

      for (let j = 0; j < tokens.length; j++) {

      }
      719+
      720+

      723+
      724+

      }

      <body>
      220+
      221+
      <div class="progress-bar" id="progress"></div>
      222+
      223+
      <div class="deck">
      224+
      225+
      <!-- ─── SLIDE 1: COVER ─────────────────────────────────────── -->
      226+
      <section class="slide cover active">
      227+
      <div class="logo">A</div>
      228+
      <div class="kicker">Vaswani et al. · 2017 · Google Brain</div>
      229+
      <h1>Attention Is All You Need</h1>
      230+
      <p class="tagline">How a 2017 paper taught computers to understand language by letting words look at each other.</p>
      231+
      <div class="paper-cite">arXiv:1706.03762 — the paper that built GPT, Claude, BERT, T5</div>
      232+
      </section>
      233+
      234+
      <!-- ─── SLIDE 2: THE PROBLEM ────────────────────────────────── -->
      235+
      <section class="slide">
      236+
      <div class="kicker">The Problem · Before 2017</div>
      237+
      <h2>Reading word by word was slow and forgetful</h2>
      238+
      <p class="lead">Old models (RNN / LSTM) processed sentences one word at a time, like reading aloud. By the end of a long sentence, they had often forgotten the start.</p>
      239+
      240+
      <div class="two-col" style="margin-top: 24px;">
      241+
      <div>
      242+
      <h3 style="color: var(--coral);">Old way: sequential</h3>
      243+
      <div class="sentence">
      244+
      <span class="token">The</span>
      245+
      <span class="token dim">cat</span>
      246+
      <span class="token dim">will</span>
      247+
      <span class="token dim">sit</span>
      248+
      <span class="token dim">on</span>
      249+
      <span class="token dim">mat</span>
      250+
      </div>
      251+
      <p style="font-size: 14px;">Step 1 → Step 2 → Step 3 → ... can't parallelize. Memory fades.</p>
      252+
      </div>
      253+
      <div>
      254+
      <h3 style="color: var(--green);">New way: parallel attention</h3>
      255+
      <div class="sentence">
      256+
      <span class="token highlight">The</span>
      257+
      <span class="token highlight">cat</span>
      258+
      <span class="token highlight">will</span>
      259+
      <span class="token highlight">sit</span>
      260+
      <span class="token highlight">on</span>
      261+
      <span class="token highlight">mat</span>
      262+
      </div>
      263+
      <p style="font-size: 14px;">All words seen at once. Each word looks at every other word.</p>
      264+
      </div>
      265+
      </div>
      266+
      267+
      <div class="callout">
      268+
      <strong>Big idea:</strong> Throw away sequence. Let every word "pay attention" to every other word, in parallel.
      269+
      </div>
      270+
      </section>
      271+
      272+
      <!-- ─── SLIDE 3: TOKENIZATION ──────────────────────────────── -->
      273+
      <section class="slide">
      274+
      <div class="kicker">Step 1 · Tokenize</div>
      275+
      <h2>Sentence becomes pieces (tokens)</h2>
      276+
      <p class="lead">Break text into small units the model can handle. Could be whole words, parts of words, or punctuation.</p>
      277+
      278+
      <div style="background: var(--paper-2); border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; margin: 20px 0;">
      279+
      <p style="color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em;">Input sentence</p>
      280+
      <p class="mono" style="font-size: 20px; color: var(--ink); margin: 0;">"The cat will sit on the mat"</p>
      281+
      </div>
      282+
      283+
      <p style="color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; margin-bottom: 10px;">After tokenization</p>
      284+
      <div class="sentence">
      285+
      <span class="token">The</span>
      286+
      <span class="token">cat</span>
      287+
      <span class="token">will</span>
      288+
      <span class="token">sit</span>
      289+
      <span class="token">on</span>
      290+
      <span class="token">the</span>
      291+
      <span class="token">mat</span>
      292+
      </div>
      293+
      294+
      <div class="callout">
      295+
      Each token gets a unique ID — e.g. <code>The</code> = 464, <code>cat</code> = 3797. Just integers so far.
      296+
      </div>
      297+
      </section>
      298+
      299+
      <!-- ─── SLIDE 4: EMBEDDINGS ────────────────────────────────── -->
      300+
      <section class="slide">
      301+
      <div class="kicker">Step 2 · Embed</div>
      302+
      <h2>Each token becomes a vector (a list of numbers)</h2>
      303+
      <p class="lead">Integer ID alone tells us nothing. The model learns to map each token to a vector that captures its meaning. Similar words land near each other.</p>
      304+
      305+
      <div style="margin: 20px 0;">
      306+
      <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0 8px;">
      307+
      <tr>
      308+
      <td><span class="token">cat</span></td>
      309+
      <td style="padding: 0 18px; color: var(--muted);">→</td>
      310+
      <td><span class="vector"><span>0.21</span><span>-0.83</span><span>0.47</span><span>0.12</span><span>...</span><span>0.55</span></span></td>
      311+
      <td style="padding-left: 16px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px;">(512 numbers)</td>
      312+
      </tr>
      313+
      <tr>
      314+
      <td><span class="token">sit</span></td>
      315+
      <td style="padding: 0 18px; color: var(--muted);">→</td>
      316+
      <td><span class="vector"><span>-0.05</span><span>0.41</span><span>0.62</span><span>-0.31</span><span>...</span><span>0.18</span></span></td>
      317+
      <td style="padding-left: 16px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px;">close to "lie", "rest"</td>
      318+
      </tr>
      319+
      <tr>
      320+
      <td><span class="token">mat</span></td>
      321+
      <td style="padding: 0 18px; color: var(--muted);">→</td>
      322+
      <td><span class="vector"><span>0.33</span><span>-0.12</span><span>-0.78</span><span>0.55</span><span>...</span><span>-0.22</span></span></td>
      323+
      <td style="padding-left: 16px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px;">close to "rug", "carpet"</td>
      324+
      </tr>
      325+
      </table>
      326+
      </div>
      327+
      328+
      <div class="callout">
      329+
      <strong>Geometry of meaning:</strong> words with related meanings have similar vectors. Math can now compare them.
      330+
      </div>
      331+
      </section>
      332+
      333+
      <!-- ─── SLIDE 5: Q, K, V ─────────────────────────────────────── -->
      334+
      <section class="slide">
      335+
      <div class="kicker">Step 3 · Query, Key, Value</div>
      336+
      <h2>Each word produces three different views of itself</h2>
      337+
      <p class="lead">From each word vector, three new vectors are created via learned weight matrices. Think of a library:</p>
      338+
      339+
      <div class="kp-grid">
      340+
      <div class="kp-card">
      341+
      <h4>Q — Query</h4>
      342+
      <p>"What am I looking for?" — what this word wants to know about other words.</p>
      343+
      </div>
      344+
      <div class="kp-card">
      345+
      <h4>K — Key</h4>
      346+
      <p>"What do I offer?" — a label other words use to find this one.</p>
      347+
      </div>
      348+
      <div class="kp-card">
      349+
      <h4>V — Value</h4>
      350+
      <p>"What I actually carry" — the content this word contributes if attended to.</p>
      351+
      </div>
      352+
      <div class="kp-card">
      353+
      <h4>Library analogy</h4>
      354+
      <p>You ask a question (Q). Library catalog has tags (K). The book itself is V. Match Q to K, fetch V.</p>
      355+
      </div>
      356+
      </div>
      357+
      358+
      <div style="margin-top: 24px;">
      359+
      <div class="sentence">
      360+
      <span class="token q">cat<sub>Q</sub></span>
      361+
      <span class="token k">cat<sub>K</sub></span>
      362+
      <span class="token v">cat<sub>V</sub></span>
      363+
      <span style="color: var(--muted); padding: 0 8px;">|</span>
      364+
      <span class="token q">sit<sub>Q</sub></span>
      365+
      <span class="token k">sit<sub>K</sub></span>
      366+
      <span class="token v">sit<sub>V</sub></span>
      367+
      </div>
      368+
      </div>
      369+
      </section>
      370+
      371+
      <!-- ─── SLIDE 6: ATTENTION SCORE ─────────────────────────────── -->
      372+
      <section class="slide">
      373+
      <div class="kicker">Step 4 · Score</div>
      374+
      <h2>How much does "sit" care about every other word?</h2>
      375+
      <p class="lead">Take "sit"'s Query, dot-product it with every other word's Key. High number = strong match.</p>
      376+
      377+
      <div style="background: var(--paper-2); border-radius: 12px; padding: 22px; margin: 18px 0;">
      378+
      <p style="color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; margin-bottom: 14px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em;">
      379+
      Raw scores for "sit" looking at each word
      380+
      </p>
      381+
      <div style="display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px;">
      382+
      <span class="token q">sit<sub>Q</sub></span>
      383+
      <span style="color: var(--muted);">·</span>
      384+
      <span class="token k">The<sub>K</sub></span>
      385+
      <span style="color: var(--muted);">=</span>
      386+
      <span style="color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600;">0.8</span>
      387+
      <span style="color: var(--muted); padding: 0 6px;">|</span>
      388+

      538+
      <p class="lead">A single attention pass captures one "view" of how words relate. Multi-head attention runs 8 (or more) separate attention computations in parallel — each free to learn a different pattern.</p>

      <div class="kp-grid">
      541+
      <div class="kp-card">

      </div>

      607+
      <h2>One idea, three superpowers</h2>
      608+
      609+

      610+

      </div>
      614+

      </div>

      </div>
      622+

      623+
      <h4>4. General purpose</h4>

      <script>
      679+
      const slides = document.querySelectorAll(".slide");
      680+
      const progress = document.getElementById("progress");
      681+
      const counter = document.getElementById("counter");
      682+
      let idx = 0;
      683+
      684+
      function show(n) {
      685+
      if (n < 0 || n >= slides.length) return;
      686+
      slides[idx].classList.remove("active");
      687+
      idx = n;
      688+
      slides[idx].classList.add("active");
      689+
      counter.textContent = (idx + 1) + " / " + slides.length;
      690+
      progress.style.width = ((idx + 1) / slides.length * 100) + "%";
      691+
      if (slides[idx].querySelector("#heatmapTarget")) renderHeatmap();
      692+
      }
      693+
      694+
      document.getElementById("prevBtn").addEventListener("click", () => show(idx - 1));
      695+
      document.getElementById("nextBtn").addEventListener("click", () => show(idx + 1));
      696+
      697+
      document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
      698+
      if (e.key === "ArrowRight" || e.key === " ") { show(idx + 1); e.preventDefault(); }
      699+
      if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") show(idx - 1);
      700+
      if (e.key.toLowerCase() === "f") {
      701+
      if (!document.fullscreenElement) document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();
      702+
      else document.exitFullscreen();
      703+
      }
      704+
      });
      705+
      706+
      // Attention heatmap (simulated weights for "the cat will sit on the mat")
      707+
      const tokens = ["The", "cat", "will", "sit", "on", "the", "mat"];
      708+
      const W = [
      709+
      [0.40, 0.35, 0.05, 0.05, 0.03, 0.04, 0.08],
      710+
      [0.08, 0.20, 0.05, 0.42, 0.05, 0.05, 0.15],
      711+
      [0.05, 0.20, 0.18, 0.45, 0.04, 0.03, 0.05],
      712+
      [0.04, 0.45, 0.06, 0.10, 0.05, 0.05, 0.25],
      713+
      [0.05, 0.18, 0.04, 0.30, 0.08, 0.10, 0.25],
      714+
      [0.10, 0.12, 0.03, 0.10, 0.05, 0.20, 0.40],
      715+
      [0.05, 0.30, 0.03, 0.20, 0.10, 0.05, 0.27],
      716+
      ];
      717+
      718+
      function renderHeatmap() {
      719+
      const t = document.getElementById("heatmapTarget");
      720+
      if (!t || t.dataset.rendered) return;
      721+
      for (let r = 0; r < tokens.length; r++) {
      722+
      const rowLabel = document.createElement("div");
      723+
      rowLabel.className = "label";
      724+
      rowLabel.style.textAlign = "right";
      725+
      rowLabel.textContent = tokens[r];
      726+
      t.appendChild(rowLabel);
      727+
      for (let c = 0; c < tokens.length; c++) {
      728+
      const cell = document.createElement("div");
      729+
      cell.className = "cell";
      730+
      const v = W[r][c];
      731+
      const alpha = Math.min(1, 0.15 + v * 1.8);
      732+
      cell.style.background = `rgba(201, 100, 66, ${alpha})`;
      733+
      cell.style.color = v > 0.25 ? "white" : "#1f1e1d";
      734+
      cell.textContent = v.toFixed(2);
      735+
      t.appendChild(cell);
      736+
      }
      737+
      }
      738+
      t.dataset.rendered = "1";
      739+
      }
      740+
      renderHeatmap();
      741+
      show(0);
      742+
      </script>
      743+
      744+
